snippet.title: Dino Cleanup | Official Trailer 05/2026
snippet.description:
Dino Cleanup is a wholesome clean-a-thon platformer with physics-elements and a retro aesthetic. 

Toxic goop has spread across the dinosaur land! Suck up the mess with your trusty vacuum and save the dinosaurs trapped in the muck. Jump, dash, vacuum, and explore multiple levels full of physics-based fun in a 3D world with 2D pixel sprites! Can you find the source of the goop and restore balance to the dino world?

Features
- Explore multiple levels by platforming, interacting with physics objects using your vacuum, and be rewarded for cleaning each level fully
- Make dinosaur friends by saving them from the goop, and chat with them back at the hub
- Find hidden collectibles and exchange them for hats!
- Unlock new abilities, revealing new ways to play, explore, and clean more efficiently
- Pull and push physics-based objects using your trusty vacuum

Clean Giant Dinosaurs! The world has been covered in goop, which includes giant dinosaurs! Use the environment and all the tools at your disposal to clean every nook and cranny!

Upgrade Your Vacuum! There are multiple kinds of goop to clean in the world, and each affects the world in different ways. Unlock upgrades to your vacuum for overdrive effects specific to each type of goop, providing very different gameplay experiences!

Make Dinosaur Friends! The dinosaur world has been covered in goop, trapping lots of cute characters. Save them from the goop with your trusty vacuum and they'll be waiting for you back at the hub. There you can chat with them between levels, buy hats, and restore the Life Tree to unlock new levels!

Wishlist on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3031750/Dino_Cleanup/
